message.content: {"verdict": "accept", "score": 0.65, "reasons": ["Defines measurable success metrics with definitions, measurement methods, and targets (e.g., LCP, INP, CLS, sessions, bounce rate, conversion rates, RPV/AOV, latency, error rate, uptime, third-party scripts, WCAG violations).", "Provides data sources and explicit access requirements (GA4, BigQuery, DBs, logs, monitoring, RUM, Lighthouse/WebPageTest) and exact access steps for GA4/BigQuery, plus a plan if access is missing.", "Includes measurement windows and segmentation (7d, 28d, 90d, 12mo; device, geography, channel, new vs returning, landing pages).", "Offers sample baselines and industry references (e.g., Baymard 70% cart abandonment) to enable planning in the absence of live data.", "Acknowledge absence of live credentials and presents concrete steps to obtain data and run queries."] , "guidance": ""}
